chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abdullah ibn Sin'an, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
My nation has not been given less than three [qualities]: beauty, a good voice, and memory.
ai.seo_question: What are the three qualities that the Prophet said his nation was given?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this hadith identifies physical beauty, a melodious voice, and strong memory as innate divine gifts bestowed upon the Prophet’s community, distinguishing them in both spiritual and worldly realms. These attributes are not merely aesthetic but serve as means of facilitating the reception and transmission of divine knowledge, reflecting the holistic excellence (ihsan) valued in Shia tradition.
